import MeasureTheory.Measure.Gaussian
import MeasureTheory.NullSingletonClass

open MeasureTheory

theorem lg_target {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} [ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussian μ] [CompleteSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] (h : ∀ (x : E), μ ≠ MeasureTheory.Measure.dirac x) : MeasureTheory.NullSingletonClass μ := by
  have h_abs_cont : μ.is_absolutely_continuous_with_measure (MeasureTheory.lebesgue E) :=
    ProbabilityTheory.gaussian_is_absolutely_continuous μ
  have h_singleton_null : ∀ (x : E), MeasureTheory.measure (MeasureTheory.lebesgue E) ({x} : Set E) = 0 :=
    fun x => by rw [MeasureTheory.measure_singleton_zero]
  rw [MeasureTheory.null_singleton_class_iff]
  intro x
  have h_null : μ {x} = 0 :=
    by
      apply MeasureTheory.absolutely_continuous_zero
      exact h_abs_cont
      exact h_singleton_null x
  exact h_null
